# FIS-B fixtures

## tg30.978

- **Origin:** fisb-decode, https://github.com/rand-projects/fisb-decode,
  file `tg/tg-source/generated/tg30.978`. Fetched by
  `scripts/fetch-test-captures.sh` at commit
  `c3d3b0473429336b1a98672b2e8b276c24d49765` (the file's content equals the
  2026-11-01 snapshot first used). SHA-256
  `6df9e5671b501e4317bc7f7b661e3931bf461d47f3666e853457e7f6abd45583`, MD5
  `13828213408db1a6884887e14caebdcb`, 866470 bytes, 1048 lines.
- **Licence:** BSD-2-Clause Plus Patent, Copyright (C) 2020-2021 Michael Barnes.
  The full text is in `LICENSE.fisb-decode` next to this file. The fixture is
  redistributed unchanged.
- **What it is:** a test group generated by fisb-decode's author (not an RTCA
  test group). It has no expected outputs upstream.
- **Line format:** one uplink per line,
  `+<864 hex digits>;rs=<n>;rssi=<dBFS>;t=<unix seconds>.<ms>;` (dump978-fa
  raw format). The hex is the 432-byte post-FEC uplink payload. Timestamps are
  from October 2020. 85 lines start with `#` (generator comments such as
  `#  RECENTER 15 -> 1767 i:1167`), which a reader must skip. The other 963
  lines are uplinks.
- **Contents** (checked by `test_fisb_frame/fixture_tg30_parses`; see
  `docs/fisb-reference.md` §1.2, §2, §3 and §9):
  - Information frames: 6169 FIS-B APDUs (type 0), 17 Current Report Lists
    (type 14) and 46 service status frames (type 15).
  - APDUs by product ID: 8 NOTAM 421, 11 AIRMET 232, 12 SIGMET 20, 13 SUA 35,
    14 G-AIRMET 262, 63 NEXRAD regional 898, 64 NEXRAD CONUS 1087,
    70 icing low 369, 71 icing high 117, 84 cloud tops 714,
    90 turbulence low 440, 91 turbulence high 220, 103 lightning 100,
    413 generic text 1254. There are no products 15-17.
  - Time options: 5199 APDUs with T-opt 0 (hh:mm) and 970 with T-opt 2
    (mm/dd hh:mm). T-opts 1 and 3 do not appear.
  - Segmented APDUs: products 8 and 14 only.

## Related

The 2015 dump978 sample (`+hex;` / `-hex;` lines, no timestamps; 704 uplinks
from one ground station) is `../raw/uat-sample.txt.gz`. See
`docs/fisb-reference.md` §9.

## received-with-uplinks.jsonl

- **What it is:** a received-stream recording with FIS-B (SHA-256
  `2ee0a8e9805bf6f0afa14121d9807f8f5ed8f69a312253c9d05e22a36a4ca346`), for replay tests
  (`test_fisb_decoder/replay_decodes_uplinks_on_recording_clock`,
  `recording_fisb_stream_written`) and the later UI tests. 1065 lines,
  about 820 kB: the 704 uplinks of `../raw/uat-sample.txt.gz` as
  `"type":"uat_uplink"` records at 1 Hz from `2015-01-24T04:12:00.000Z`
  (the sample's NEXRAD is from 04:10 and its METARs from about 03:53 that
  day, so everything stays inside its lifetime for the whole file), and the
  first 30 s of `../readsb-sample.jsonl` (361 readsb JSON-port lines,
  unchanged except their `"now"`, moved onto the same 2015 clock), in time
  order.
- **How it is made:** `python3 gen_received_with_uplinks.py [--fixtures DIR]` (deterministic; rerun it after changing either input). Derived from the
  BSD-2-Clause dump978 sample and the repository's own synthetic readsb data.

## received-tg30.jsonl

- **What it is:** the 963 uplinks of `tg30.978` as a received-stream
  recording (`"type":"uat_uplink"` records, each at its own `t=` time,
  2020-10-30 08:52:40-09:00:17 UTC), about 900 kB; the same conversion as
  `tests/test_fisb_web.cpp`'s `tg30AsRecording`. The UI tests
  (`tests/ui/ui.spec.js`) replay it for radar: unlike the 2015 sample (all
  level 0), its NEXRAD regional mosaic (861 blocks, 36.7-43.3 N,
  90.4-81.6 W) and CONUS mosaic (1413 blocks, 20-53 N, 132-60 W) carry
  echoes, and it has the raster layers and AIRMETs.
- **How it is made:** `python3 gen_received_tg30.py [--fixtures DIR]` (deterministic). Derived from `tg30.978` (BSD-2-Clause Plus Patent,
  `LICENSE.fisb-decode`).

## tg30.golden.sha256

- **What it is:** the SHA-256 of `skycue-fisb --json --ref-date 2020-10-30
  tg30.978`, the store's events for tg30 (1.69 MB, not kept). The `fisb_cli`
  test hashes a fresh run and compares it with this single hex string.
- **Provenance:** generated by skycue-fisb itself and checked record by record
  against fisb-decode's level 0-2 output for the same file. The invocation,
  the check script and the adjudicated differences are in
  `scripts/fisb-golden.md`. Derived from `tg30.978` (BSD-2-Clause Plus Patent,
  `LICENSE.fisb-decode`).
